name: Fund Liquidity 80 — FL26131 (long-only)
spec: All 582 eligible BIST names. Score = 25% risk-adjusted 126d momentum + 75% trend (52-week-high proximity + robust 126d trend) within the low-beta half. Buy the top 75, weight by liquidity percentile, 85% invested (rest in TRY cash at 40%/yr), rebalance on the last session of each 2-week block; 5 bp x turnover.
deviations: Traded value = Yahoo close x volume (original: exchange TRY traded value).
Prices: Yahoo adjusted closes (original vendor adjustments may differ for bonus/rights issues).
Market-cap > 0 gate treated as always true (no Yahoo history).
backtest_note: Backtest from 2020-01-02, the original research start (its TRY cash-rate table begins in 2020).
